public_record.desc:
Estimates of 2025, total number of people per grid-cell. The dataset is available to download in Geotiff format at a resolution of 30 arc (approximately 1km at the equator). The projection is Geographic Coordinate System, WGS84. The units are number of people per pixel. The mapping approach is Random Forest-based dasymetric redistribution.More information can be found in the Release Statement.

 

Disclaimer:

The dataset currently represents an alpha version (R2025A) product and may change over the coming year as improvements are made.

description: Alpha population estimates, people per native pixel; not census observation
